snippet.title: Barony: Deserters & Disciples DLC - Full Reveal Announcement
snippet.description:
Turning Wheel is proud to  present 5 new races & classes in the Deserters & Disciples DLC.
This ships simultaneously with Part 1 of the FREE "Instruments of Destruction" update and adds major new features and content! Overhauled magic system with dozens of new spells & magic items, some new equipment, enhanced late-game level designs, balance tweaks, lock & key treasure rooms, cooking, and more.

Buy Deserters & Disiples now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010822/Barony_Deserters__Disciples_DLC_Pack_3/

GoG:
https://www.gog.com/en/game/barony_deserters_disciples
